info.description: Production-ready Postman Collection for The Coach Profile (crstew05-backend). Contains comprehensive endpoints for Authentication, Coach Profiles, Organizations, Opportunities, Candidates Pipeline, Shortlists, Verifications, Subscriptions, Chat/Messages, Analytics, Support, Location, and an Automated Agentic End-to-End Test Suite.
